## Description

Template model (sections, prompts, required fields, quick phrases) with versioning; seed the six designed templates and specialty variants requested by the pilot doctors; templates selectable in onboarding and settings.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Six base templates exist and are reviewed by the clinical advisor.
- [ ] **AC2.** Each pilot doctor has their specialty template(s) configured before R2.
- [ ] **AC3.** Template changes create new versions; existing notes keep the version they used.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
